_readme: Verified trial identifiers. Each entry was resolved through PubMed and its DOI compared against the DOI in src/data/trialData.ts. check:identifiers fails if a record's pmid/doi pair drifts from this file, or if a record gains an identifier that has never been resolved. Re-verify with the PubMed MCP tools and update this file; do NOT hand-edit an entry to silence the check.
_note: IST and CAST (both Lancet 1997) have no DOI in PubMed; resolvedDoi is null and the title was checked by hand instead.
